firstSteps: Run npm run dev to launch the extension
Open any web page and an element appears in each of its four corners
Edit one script in src/content/ and save to see that corner update
useCases: Four scripts shipped from a single content-script entry
One match rule driving several focused files
Reference for grouping content scripts under one entry

store.summary: Injects four small elements into web pages.

justifications.Host permission <all_urls>: The content script runs on the pages the user visits to render the extension's on-page interface. Narrow this to the specific sites your extension needs before submitting.
